   457	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)
   458	def _count_candidates_per_col_nb(query_mz: np.ndarray,
   459	                                 query_int: np.ndarray,
   460	                                 has_pmz: bool,
   461	                                 query_pmz: float,
   462	                                 peaks_mz: np.ndarray, peaks_spec_idx: np.ndarray,
   463	                                 nl_mz: np.ndarray, nl_spec_idx: np.ndarray, nl_prod_idx: np.ndarray,
   464	                                 tol: float, use_ppm: bool,
   465	                                 do_frag: bool, do_nl: bool,
   466	                                 n_cols: int) -> np.ndarray:
   467	    """
   468	    Count (fragment + neutral loss) candidate pairs per column (library spectrum).
   469	
   470	    Returns
   471	    -------
   472	    counts_by_col : int32[n_cols]
   473	        Number of candidate (i,j) pairs that belong to each library spectrum (column).
   474	    """
   475	    counts = np.zeros(n_cols, dtype=np.int32)
   476	
   477	    # Fragment matches
   478	    if do_frag:
   479	        for i in range(query_mz.shape[0]):
   480	            Iq = float(query_int[i])
   481	            if Iq <= 0.0:
   482	                continue
   483	
   484	            mz = float(query_mz[i])
   485	            a, b = _search_spec_in_fragment_window(peaks_mz, mz, tol, use_ppm)
   486	            for j in range(a, b):
   487	                # exact symmetric check to trim the searchsorted window
   488	                if _within_tol_nb(mz, float(peaks_mz[j]), tol, use_ppm):
   489	                    col = int(peaks_spec_idx[j])
   490	                    counts[col] += 1
   491	
   492	    # Neutral-loss matches
   493	    if do_nl and has_pmz and (nl_mz.size > 0):
   494	        for i in range(query_mz.shape[0]):
   495	            Iq = float(query_int[i])
   496	            if Iq <= 0.0:
   497	                continue
   498	
   499	            loss = query_pmz - float(query_mz[i])
   500	            a, b = _search_spec_in_fragment_window(nl_mz, loss, tol, use_ppm)
   501	            for k in range(a, b):
   502	                if _within_tol_nb(loss, float(nl_mz[k]), tol, use_ppm):
   503	                    col = int(nl_spec_idx[k])
   504	                    counts[col] += 1
   505	
   506	    return counts
   507

   509	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)
   510	def _fill_candidates_per_col_nb(query_mz: np.ndarray,
   511	                                query_int: np.ndarray,
   512	                                has_pmz: bool, qpmz: float,
   513	                                peaks_mz: np.ndarray, peaks_int: np.ndarray, peaks_spec_idx: np.ndarray,
   514	                                nl_mz: np.ndarray, nl_spec_idx: np.ndarray, nl_prod_idx: np.ndarray,
   515	                                tol: float, use_ppm: bool,
   516	                                do_frag: bool, do_nl: bool,
   517	                                col_offsets: np.ndarray,  # int64, length n_cols+1
   518	                                counts_by_col: np.ndarray,  # int64, length n_cols
   519	                                use_entropy: bool
   520	                                ) -> tuple:
   521	    """
   522	    Materialize all candidates in CSR-like form grouped by column.
   523	
   524	    Parameters
   525	    ----------
   526	    col_offsets : int64[n_cols+1]
   527	        Prefix sums of counts (0, c0, c0+c1, ...).
   528	    counts_by_col : int64[n_cols]
   529	        As returned by _count_candidates_per_col_nb.
   530	
   531	    Returns
   532	    -------
   533	    ref_idx  : int32[n_total]
   534	    lib_idx  : int32[n_total]
   535	    score    : float64[n_total]
   536	        Entropy increment or intensity product for each candidate, according
   537	        to ``use_entropy``.
   538	    is_frag  : uint8[n_total]   (1 if fragment, 0 if NL)
   539	    """
   540	    n_cols = counts_by_col.shape[0]
   541	    n_total = int(col_offsets[n_cols])
   542	
   543	    ref_idx = np.empty(n_total, dtype=np.int32)
   544	    lib_idx = np.empty(n_total, dtype=np.int32)
   545	    score   = np.empty(n_total, dtype=np.float64)
   546	    is_frag = np.empty(n_total, dtype=np.uint8)
   547	
   548	    # Running write cursors per column
   549	    pos = col_offsets[:-1].copy()
   550	
   551	    # Fragment matches
   552	    if do_frag:
   553	        for i in range(query_mz.shape[0]):
   554	            Iq = float(query_int[i])
   555	            if Iq <= 0.0:
   556	                continue
   557	
   558	            mz = float(query_mz[i])
   559	            a, b = _search_spec_in_fragment_window(peaks_mz, mz, tol, use_ppm)
   560	            for j in range(a, b):
   561	                mj = float(peaks_mz[j])
   562	                if not _within_tol_nb(mz, mj, tol, use_ppm):
   563	                    continue
   564	
   565	                spec_idx = int(peaks_spec_idx[j])
   566	                col_idx = int(pos[spec_idx])
   567	                ref_idx[col_idx] = i
   568	                lib_idx[col_idx] = j
   569	                Ilib = float(peaks_int[j])
   570	                if use_entropy:
   571	                    low_intensity = min(Iq, Ilib)
   572	                    high_intensity = max(Iq, Ilib)
   573	                    score[col_idx] = (_xlog2_scalar_nb(low_intensity + high_intensity)
   574	                                      - _xlog2_scalar_nb(low_intensity)
   575	                                      - _xlog2_scalar_nb(high_intensity))
   576	                else:
   577	                    score[col_idx] = Iq * Ilib
   578	                is_frag[col_idx] = 1
   579	                pos[spec_idx] = col_idx + 1
   580	
   581	    # Neutral-loss matches
   582	    if do_nl and has_pmz and (nl_mz.size > 0):
   583	        for i in range(query_mz.shape[0]):
   584	            Iq = float(query_int[i])
   585	            if Iq <= 0.0:
   586	                continue
   587	
   588	            loss = qpmz - float(query_mz[i])
   589	            a, b = _search_spec_in_fragment_window(nl_mz, loss, tol, use_ppm)
   590	            for k in range(a, b):
   591	                mk = float(nl_mz[k])
   592	                if not _within_tol_nb(loss, mk, tol, use_ppm):
   593	                    continue
   594	
   595	                j = int(nl_prod_idx[k])        # product-peak index in global arrays
   596	                spec_idx = int(nl_spec_idx[k])
   597	                col_idx = int(pos[spec_idx])
   598	                ref_idx[col_idx] = i
   599	                lib_idx[col_idx] = j
   600	                Ilib = float(peaks_int[j])
   601	                if use_entropy:
   602	                    low_intensity = min(Iq, Ilib)
   603	                    high_intensity = max(Iq, Ilib)
   604	                    score[col_idx] = (_xlog2_scalar_nb(low_intensity + high_intensity)
   605	                                      - _xlog2_scalar_nb(low_intensity)
   606	                                      - _xlog2_scalar_nb(high_intensity))
   607	                else:
   608	                    score[col_idx] = Iq * Ilib
   609	                is_frag[col_idx] = 0
   610	                pos[spec_idx] = col_idx + 1
   611	
   612	    return ref_idx, lib_idx, score, is_frag
   613

   615	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True, inline="always")
   616	def _candidate_is_better_nb(candidate_a: int, candidate_b: int,
   617	                            ref_idx: np.ndarray, lib_idx: np.ndarray,
   618	                            score: np.ndarray, is_frag: np.ndarray,
   619	                            ref_mz: np.ndarray, ref_int: np.ndarray, ref_pmz: float,
   620	                            lib_mz: np.ndarray, lib_int: np.ndarray, lib_pmz: float) -> bool:
   621	    """Compare candidates using a direction-independent ordering."""
   622	    score_a = float(score[candidate_a])
   623	    score_b = float(score[candidate_b])
   624	    if score_a != score_b:
   625	        return score_a > score_b
   626	
   627	    frag_a = int(is_frag[candidate_a])
   628	    frag_b = int(is_frag[candidate_b])
   629	    if frag_a != frag_b:
   630	        return frag_a > frag_b
   631	
   632	    ref_a = int(ref_idx[candidate_a])
   633	    ref_b = int(ref_idx[candidate_b])
   634	    lib_a = int(lib_idx[candidate_a])
   635	    lib_b = int(lib_idx[candidate_b])
   636	
   637	    mass_ref_a = float(ref_mz[ref_a])
   638	    mass_ref_b = float(ref_mz[ref_b])
   639	    mass_lib_a = float(lib_mz[lib_a])
   640	    mass_lib_b = float(lib_mz[lib_b])
   641	    if frag_a == 0:
   642	        mass_ref_a = ref_pmz - mass_ref_a
   643	        mass_ref_b = ref_pmz - mass_ref_b
   644	        mass_lib_a = lib_pmz - mass_lib_a
   645	        mass_lib_b = lib_pmz - mass_lib_b
   646	
   647	    delta_a = abs(mass_ref_a - mass_lib_a)
   648	    delta_b = abs(mass_ref_b - mass_lib_b)
   649	    if delta_a != delta_b:
   650	        return delta_a < delta_b
   651	
   652	    low_mass_a = min(mass_ref_a, mass_lib_a)
   653	    low_mass_b = min(mass_ref_b, mass_lib_b)
   654	    if low_mass_a != low_mass_b:
   655	        return low_mass_a < low_mass_b
   656	    high_mass_a = max(mass_ref_a, mass_lib_a)
   657	    high_mass_b = max(mass_ref_b, mass_lib_b)
   658	    if high_mass_a != high_mass_b:
   659	        return high_mass_a < high_mass_b
   660	
   661	    low_int_a = min(float(ref_int[ref_a]), float(lib_int[lib_a]))
   662	    low_int_b = min(float(ref_int[ref_b]), float(lib_int[lib_b]))
   663	    if low_int_a != low_int_b:
   664	        return low_int_a > low_int_b
   665	    high_int_a = max(float(ref_int[ref_a]), float(lib_int[lib_a]))
   666	    high_int_b = max(float(ref_int[ref_b]), float(lib_int[lib_b]))
   667	    if high_int_a != high_int_b:
   668	        return high_int_a > high_int_b
   669	
   670	    # At this point the candidates have identical scientific attributes and
   671	    # their peaks are interchangeable. This final key only makes the sort total.
   672	    return candidate_a < candidate_b
   673	
   674	
   675	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)
   676	def _candidate_order_nb(ref_idx: np.ndarray, lib_idx: np.ndarray,
   677	                        score: np.ndarray, is_frag: np.ndarray,
   678	                        ref_mz: np.ndarray, ref_int: np.ndarray, ref_pmz: float,
   679	                        lib_mz: np.ndarray, lib_int: np.ndarray, lib_pmz: float) -> np.ndarray:
   680	    """Return a deterministic merge-sort order for one spectrum pair's candidates."""
   681	    size = score.shape[0]
   682	    order = np.arange(size, dtype=np.int64)
   683	    scratch = np.empty(size, dtype=np.int64)
   684	    width = 1
   685	
   686	    while width < size:
   687	        left = 0
   688	        while left < size:
   689	            middle = min(left + width, size)
   690	            right = min(left + 2 * width, size)
   691	            i = left
   692	            j = middle
   693	            write = left
   694	            while i < middle and j < right:
   695	                if _candidate_is_better_nb(
   696	                        int(order[i]), int(order[j]), ref_idx, lib_idx, score, is_frag,
   697	                        ref_mz, ref_int, ref_pmz, lib_mz, lib_int, lib_pmz):
   698	                    scratch[write] = order[i]
   699	                    i += 1
   700	                else:
   701	                    scratch[write] = order[j]
   702	                    j += 1
   703	                write += 1
   704	            while i < middle:
   705	                scratch[write] = order[i]
   706	                i += 1
   707	                write += 1
   708	            while j < right:
   709	                scratch[write] = order[j]
   710	                j += 1
   711	                write += 1
   712	            left = right
   713	        order, scratch = scratch, order
   714	        width *= 2
   715	
   716	    return order

   719	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)
   720	def _greedy_scores_all_cols_nb(n_cols: int,
   721	                               n_q: int,
   722	                               col_offsets: np.ndarray,        # int64[n_cols+1]
   723	                               ref_idx: np.ndarray,            # int32[n_total]
   724	                               lib_idx: np.ndarray,            # int32[n_total]
   725	                               score: np.ndarray,              # float64[n_total]
   726	                               is_frag: np.ndarray,            # uint8[n_total]
   727	                               lib_spec_l2: np.ndarray,        # float64[n_cols]
   728	                               q_l2: float,
   729	                               normalize_cosine: bool,
   730	                               ref_mz: np.ndarray, ref_int: np.ndarray, ref_pmz: float,
   731	                               lib_mz: np.ndarray, lib_int: np.ndarray,
   732	                               lib_precursor_mz: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
   733	    """
   734	    Greedy, non-overlapping selection *per column* with score tie-break by fragment flag.
   735	
   736	    For each column c:
   737	      1) Build its candidate view: indices [start:end)
   738	      2) Sort entropy candidates by score and direction-independent scientific
   739	         tie keys; retain the historical fragment-priority key for cosine
   740	      3) Walk candidates; accept if neither query-peak i nor lib-peak j used yet
   741	      4) Accumulate the selected candidate contributions, optionally dividing
   742	         by L2 norms for cosine scores.
   743	
   744	    Returns
   745	    -------
   746	    out : float64[n_cols]
   747	        Entropy, cosine, or modified-cosine score per library spectrum.
   748	    """
   749	    out = np.zeros(n_cols, dtype=np.float64)
   750	    # Query-peak usage flags (small; re-init per column is cheap)
   751	    used_q = np.empty(n_q, dtype=np.uint8)
   752	
   753	    for col in range(n_cols):
